title: Nature & the physical world
note: B1 Oxford-gap leaf · ground & plants, animals & the land · 12 items · carriers via use[] · picture intro · Use bank

intro.title: The ground, the plants, the animals
intro.body: Twelve words for the world outside. Six are ground and plants, six are animals and the land itself.

intro.title: You will use these words in
intro.note: leaf has an irregular plural: one leaf, two leaves.

sentences.en: The soil in our garden is very dry.
sentences.cz: Půda v naší zahradě je velmi suchá.
accepts: The soil in our garden is very dry
The ground in our garden is very dry

sentences.en: The children are playing in the sand.
accepts: The children are playing in the sand

sentences.en: There is mud on the path.
accepts: There is mud on the path

sentences.en: There is dust on all the books.
accepts: There is dust on all the books
There's dust on all the books

sentences.en: I put the seeds in the soil.
accepts: I put the seeds in the soil
I put the seeds in the ground

sentences.en: In autumn the leaves fall from the trees.
sentences.cz: Na podzim listy padají ze stromů.
accepts: In autumn the leaves fall from the trees

sentences.en: She found a beautiful shell on the beach.
accepts: She found a beautiful shell on the beach

sentences.en: That dog has a very long tail.
sentences.cz: Ten pes má velmi dlouhý ocas.
accepts: That dog has a very long tail

sentences.en: The bird has a broken wing.
accepts: The bird has a broken wing

sentences.en: Our cat has soft white fur.
sentences.cz: Naše kočka má měkkou bílou srst.
accepts: Our cat has soft white fur

sentences.en: Where is the path to the river?
accepts: Where is the path to the river
Where's the path to the river

sentences.en: After the rain there was a flood in the village.
sentences.cz: Po dešti byla ve vesnici povodeň.
accepts: After the rain there was a flood in the village
